## Speaker
Chenxi Zeng

### Theme
Algebraic structure of 2d rational conformal field theory(1/x)

### Abstract
We will introduce the definition of a VOA, with particular emphasis on the Jacobi identity and the geometric interpretation of the operator product expansion (OPE).
